questions.question_text: A thermometer reads $11^{\circ}\text{C}$ below zero. Which integer represents the temperature?

options.why: Used a positive sign even though the temperature is below the zero reference.
Used the reference temperature itself instead of moving eleven degrees below it.
Kept only one digit of the stated eleven-degree distance below zero.

questions.solution_text: Below zero is negative, so the temperature is $-11^{\circ}\text{C}$.

questions.question_text: A tunnel entrance is the zero level. A chamber is labelled $-28$ m. What does the label mean?

options.text: The chamber is $28$ m below the entrance.
The chamber is $28$ m above the entrance.
options.why: Interpreted the negative sign as an above-zero position rather than below the entrance.

options.text: The chamber is at the entrance.
options.why: Ignored the distance $28$ and treated the negative value as the zero reference.
Read a fixed position as a change even though no movement is described.

questions.solution_text: The negative sign places the chamber below the zero level, so it is $28$ m below the entrance.

questions.question_text: A score record shows a change of $+9$. Which statement is correct?

options.why: Interpreted the positive sign as a loss rather than an increase.
Confused a change of nine points with the player's final score.
Treated the plus sign as if it described a negative final position.

questions.solution_text: A positive change means an increase, so the score increased by $9$.

questions.question_text: A lift is on floor $-5$. Which floor is the same distance from ground floor $0$ on the opposite side?

options.why: Doubled the negative floor number instead of changing to the opposite sign.
Chose the reference floor rather than the equally distant floor above it.
Moved one floor toward zero instead of reflecting across the zero floor.

questions.solution_text: $-5$ and $+5$ are both $5$ floors from $0$ on opposite sides.

questions.question_text: At noon it was $3^{\circ}\text{C}$. The temperature then fell by $8^{\circ}\text{C}$. What integer represents the new temperature?

options.why: Found the size of the difference but dropped the negative sign after crossing zero.
Added the fall of eight degrees instead of subtracting it from three.
Added the magnitudes and then made the result negative rather than subtracting from three.

questions.question_text: A climber is at $-12$ m relative to a ridge and then rises $7$ m. Which integer represents the new position?

options.why: Moved farther below the ridge by subtracting seven instead of rising seven metres.
Found the distance from zero but changed the still-below-ridge position to positive.
Added the magnitudes and ignored both the direction of change and the zero reference.

questions.question_text: A game log says ‘change $=-6$’. Which conclusion is always true?

options.why: Confused the signed change with the final score, which also depends on the starting score.
Assumed a decrease must cross zero even though the starting score is unknown.
Treated the size of the decrease as the unknown starting score.

questions.solution_text: The value $-6$ records a decrease of $6$; it does not determine the starting or final score.
